name: SmartShopBench
description: A benchmark capturing diverse shopping intents with hierarchical evaluation decomposing complex quality requirements into measurable levels, designed to optimize conversational shopping agents via reinforcement learning.
reputation: A niche, emerging benchmark for shopping agents that is not yet as widely adopted as major agent benchmarks, but is relevant for research on conversational commerce and reward modeling.
notes: Supports RL training with mixed reward types and dynamic trajectory selection; focuses on product correctness, persuasiveness, and tool efficiency.
